## Editorial standards
Each guide has dated source links and verification status. We distinguish Rockstar/PlayStation announcements, press reports, community complaints, and speculation. Online dates, crossplay and PC release must not be stated as confirmed without an official announcement.
Official sources: https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/ ; https://support.rockstargames.com/VI
